description: Activate when: someone says 'let's just remove this', 'why do we still have this rule?', 'this seems useless/outdated', 'nobody knows why this is here', new leadership restructuring without knowing the history, a developer deleting code whose purpose isn't documented, a regulator repealing a law without tracing its origin. Do NOT activate when: the fence's history is fully documented and the documented purpose is confirmed obsolete (investigation already done); the reformer is the original builder and the rationale is fully understood. More: deciqai.com/c/chestertons-fence
